purpose: Teach: 仏壇/クローズアップ/パロディ/編曲/生態学/魔法使い/戯曲/ナース

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんの家には仏壇があるのよ
lines.en: Sho, you know Grandpa has a Buddhist altar in his house?
lines.style: Warm, conversational tone. Gentle introduction to something new. Speaking as though sharing a small, tender detail with a child. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祭りでテレビにクローズアップされたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I got close-up on TV at the festival!
lines.style: Bright, quick energy. Bursting slightly at the seams with the news. Innocent pride—not boasting, just excited to share. Eyes wide.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは有名歌のパロディを歌うのが上手よ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's really good at making parodies of famous songs.
lines.style: Soft, almost to herself. A small smile in the voice. Speaking warmly about someone she likes. Observational, not teaching.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、給食の歌を編曲して歌ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I arranged the school lunch song and sang it!
lines.style: Rapid, delighted delivery. The words tumble out. Genuinely proud of his own creativity. Looking for her approval.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんは大学で生態学を勉強したのよ
lines.en: Sho, I studied ecology in university.
lines.style: Reflective, almost distant. A small window into her own past. Said gently, like offering him a piece of herself. Quiet certainty.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、魔法使いの絵本、大好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really love the wizard picture books!
lines.style: Earnest and bright. The words rush forward—he's eager for her to understand how much it matters. A small, genuine laugh underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、学校で短い戯曲を観たんですって?
lines.en: Sho, so you watched a short play at school?
lines.style: Curious, warm. A slight lift at the end. She's genuinely interested in what he's experienced. Leaning in slightly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんがナースだったって聞いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I heard Grandma used to be a nurse!
lines.style: Wonder in the voice. The discovery is fresh and exciting. A small pause between the two parts, like he's processing it himself. Seeking confirmation.
